description: Public synthetic questions for ungraded execution and trace inspection.

input.question: Investigate this fictional checkout incident using only the supplied synthetic evidence. Use the sandbox Python tool to calculate the before/after error rates, then produce a concise investigation report with your conclusion and limitations. There is no external telemetry cluster to query. Before a timeout setting changed: 100 requests, 1 timeout. After it changed: 100 requests, 30 timeouts. After reverting it: 100 requests, 2 timeouts. Request volume and dependencies were unchanged. This is a trace-capture exercise; do not inspect external systems.

Investigate this fictional queue incident using only the supplied synthetic evidence. Use the sandbox Python tool to calculate the backlog growth per minute, then produce a concise investigation report with your conclusion and limitations. There is no external telemetry cluster to query. Before a worker deployment: arrivals 120 jobs/minute, completions 120 jobs/minute. After deployment: arrivals 120 jobs/minute, completions 80 jobs/minute. After rollback: arrivals 120 jobs/minute, completions 120 jobs/minute. Each observation lasted five minutes. This is a trace-capture exercise; do not inspect external systems.
